Plugin  weather 1.2.0 · in acme

  acme ships a plugin weather. Shows the weather where you are.

  Installing runs this, as you and outside the sandbox:
    sh /src/acme/plugins/weather/install.sh

  Then rush shows what the plugin may do, and asks you to approve it.

  Install  build it, then review what it may do
